foundation_description: A non-political, non-communal spiritual organization dedicated to meditation, self-purification, universal knowledge, and human welfare — based in Rajshahi, Bangladesh.
yoga_meditation_description: Structured sessions for inner calm, self-purification, and spiritual awakening for all levels.
spiritual_growth_description: Universal Sufi-inspired programs blending ancient wisdom with modern humanitarian values.
free_education_description: Knowledge, research, and spiritual guidance freely available to every seeker regardless of background.
founder_name: Dr. Shah Syed Hasib Ul Hasan Raza,
foundation_about_description: VisvaBangla Foundation is a registered humanitarian organization under the Ministry of Social Welfare, Government of Bangladesh (Reg. No: 1012/15, July 13, 2015).
foundation_about_description_2: Inspired by the timeless wisdom of Sufi philosophy and universal humanitarian values, the foundation is working toward the establishment of the VisvaBangla Spiritual University — a unique, completely free platform for meditation, knowledge, and spiritual education open to all people regardless of religion, class, or background.
programs_description: Free and open to all — from beginners to advanced practitioners. Rooted in universal humanitarian philosophy and spiritual wisdom.
morning_yoga_flow_description: Start your day with a gentle yet energizing yoga sequence designed to awaken the body, improve flexibility, and cultivate mindful awareness.
guided_meditation_description: A structured meditation session rooted in universal humanitarian philosophy helping you release stress, find stillness, and reconnect with your inner self.
power_yoga_strength_description: Build physical strength and mental resilience through dynamic power yoga sequences guided by certified instructors for intermediate practitioners.
sufi_spiritual_meditation_description: Inspired by centuries of Sufi wisdom, this free meditation program guides seekers toward self-purification, spiritual awareness, and inner liberation.
Why_Choose_Us_description: VisvaBangla Foundation is not just an organization — it is a movement toward a peaceful, compassionate, and non-communal world through free education, meditation, and spiritual guidance.
completely_free_description: All programs — meditation, spiritual education, and knowledge sessions — are entirely free of cost, open to every seeker regardless of background.
universal_non_communal_description: Rooted in the belief that the whole world is one family. We welcome all people beyond religion, caste, or sectarian identity.
sufi_spiritual_guidance_description: Programs inspired by centuries of Sufi wisdom, guiding seekers toward self-purification, inner liberation, and spiritual awareness.
research_based_education_description: Teachers, researchers, and scholars simplify and freely distribute research-based spiritual and philosophical knowledge for all.
community_self_reliance_description: Empowering individuals — especially youth and disadvantaged communities — through training, skill development, and socio-economic participation.
humanitarian_mission_description: Working toward healthcare, legal aid, child rights, environmental protection, and housing welfare for poor and marginalized communities.
world_human_religion_center_description: Building a safe, service-oriented residential meditation center open to people from all walks of life — a sanctuary for peace and reflection.
environmental_social_action_description: Committed to afforestation, sanitation, anti-drug awareness, and environmentally friendly self-employment and cottage industries.
values_line_2: — no discrimination, no fees, no boundaries. Just truth, humanity, and spiritual freedom.

vision_description: Inspired by more than fifteen years of research, the foundation envisions a peaceful, compassionate, and non-communal world through the study, research, and publication of the philosophies of great human beings throughout history.
vision_founder_message: Nowhere in the world has a university been established solely for the free distribution of universal humanitarian and spiritual meditation-based knowledge dedicated to self-purification. We dream of building a peaceful, compassionate, and non-communal world.
universal_family_description: The whole world is one family. The foundation works globally to spread the light of universal education and spiritual guidance.
world_human_religion_center_desc: Establishing a safe, service-oriented residential meditation center open to people from all walks of life.
visvabangla_spiritual_university_descrip: A free, non-communal university of meditation, knowledge, and spiritual guidance — inspired by ancient centers like Nalanda and Taxila.
sufi_spiritual_education_description: Weekly classes, free meditation sessions, and Sufi spiritual education programs for laborers, artisans, and ordinary people deprived of formal education.
research_publications_description: Press, publication centers, research journals, and media platforms to spread universal humanitarian philosophy.
goals_description: According to the constitution approved by the District Social Services Office of the Government of Bangladesh, the aims, objectives, and ideals of VisvaBangla Foundation are as follows:
self_reliance_empowerment_description: Making spiritually guided individuals self-reliant through self-employment initiatives and vocational training for skill development.
education_institutions_description: Establishing libraries, schools, colleges, universities, press and publication centers, and media platforms to spread universal humanitarian philosophy.
youth_community_development_description: Transforming the younger generation into skilled human resources and empowering adolescents through training and socio-economic participation.
legal_aid_human_rights_description: Providing legal assistance to underprivileged people and raising legal awareness through social and human rights-based educational programs.
healthcare_social_welfare_description: Establishing charitable medical centers, maternal and child healthcare services, and rehabilitation programs for the poor and disabled.
environmental_social_action_desc: Undertaking afforestation, sanitation, anti-drug campaigns, and awareness programs for environmental development and social harmony.
government_bangladesh: Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
committee_description: The dedicated team guiding VisvaBangla Foundation toward its humanitarian and spiritual mission.
